WITH values_by_year AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year, 'factor' AS field, primary_collision_factor AS value
    FROM main.collisions
    UNION ALL
    SELECT strftime('%Y', collision_date), 'category', pcf_violation_category
    FROM main.collisions
), frequencies AS (
    SELECT year, field, value, COUNT(*) AS n,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY field, year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS position
    FROM values_by_year
    GROUP BY year, field, value
)
SELECT year, field, MAX(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN value END) AS first_value,
       MAX(CASE WHEN position = 2 THEN value END) AS second_value,
       COUNT(*) AS values_in_top_two
FROM frequencies
WHERE position <= 2
GROUP BY year, field
ORDER BY field, year

arguments.sql:
WITH cause_counts AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
           pcf_violation_category AS cause,
           COUNT(*) AS collisions
    FROM main.collisions
    WHERE pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL
      AND collision_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY year, cause
),
ranked_causes AS (
    SELECT year, cause,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY collisions DESC) AS cause_rank
    FROM cause_counts
),
yearly_pairs AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(cause) AS cause_a, MAX(cause) AS cause_b
    FROM ranked_causes
    WHERE cause_rank <= 2
    GROUP BY year
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT MIN(year) AS year
FROM yearly_pairs
GROUP BY cause_a, cause_b
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
ORDER BY year
